content.title: Import a demo in one click
content.excerpt: Pick a demo, choose Gutenberg or Elementor and import pages, menus and products in about two minutes.
content.content:
Every demo ships a Gutenberg and an Elementor version. The importer installs the plugins the demo needs, brings in pages, products, menus and images, and logs each step so you can resume if anything stops.

1. Open the Demo Library

Go to WPEssential → Demo Library in wp-admin and pick a demo.

2. Choose your builder

Select Gutenberg or Elementor. Both versions look the same.

3. Install required plugins

The wizard lists the plugins and installs them for you.

4. Import

Keep the tab open. A typical demo imports in under two minutes.

content.title: Gutenberg or Elementor: which package?
content.excerpt: Both versions look the same. Here is how to choose the right one for your site.
content.content:
Each demo is built twice, natively: once with core blocks and once with Elementor widgets. Neither is a converted copy of the other.

  • Choose Gutenberg for the fastest pages and no page-builder plugin.
  • Choose Elementor if your team already edits with it.
  • Switching later means importing the other package on a fresh site.

We moved three client sites to the Gutenberg packages and every one went above 95 on PageSpeed.

Agency customer

content.title: New demo: Pulse for conferences and events
content.excerpt: Speakers, a two-day agenda, ticket passes and The Events Calendar, ready to import.
content.content:
Pulse is our second Pro demo. It is built for conferences, meetups and anyone who sells tickets.

  • Speaker grid and profiles
  • Two-day agenda with tracks and rooms
  • Ticket passes sold through WooCommerce
  • Events calendar with venues and organisers

Pulse is included in the Pro and Agency plans, or you can buy it on its own.

Legal

Privacy Policy

Last updated 1 October 2026

Who we are

WPEssential, a Vertex Systems Network (Pvt.) Ltd. company runs this website. This policy explains what personal data we collect when you visit it, buy themes, demos, plans and services or contact us, and how we use it.

What we collect

  • Details you give us: name, email, phone, billing and delivery address when you order or get in touch.
  • Order details: what you bought, when and how you paid. Card numbers are handled by our payment provider and never stored by us.
  • Usage data: pages visited, device and browser, collected through cookies (see our Cookie Policy).

How we use it

  • To process orders, deliver what you bought and send receipts.
  • To answer questions and give support.
  • To send news or offers, only if you opted in. Every email has an unsubscribe link.
  • To keep the site secure and improve it.

Sharing

We share data only with services that help us run the business — payment, hosting, email and delivery providers — and only what they need. We never sell your data.

How long we keep it

Order records are kept for as long as tax law requires. Other data is deleted when it is no longer needed or when you ask us to.

Your rights

You can ask to see, correct, export or delete your data, or object to how we use it. Email support@wpessential.org and we will reply within 30 days.

Changes

If this policy changes we update the date at the top of the page.

What cookies are

Cookies are small files saved by your browser. They help the site work and tell us how it is used.

Cookies we use

  • Essential: keep you signed in, remember your cart and keep checkout secure. These cannot be turned off.
  • Preferences: remember choices such as language or dark mode.

Your choices
